merge_raw_images_to_hdr: merge a stack of RAW images into an HDR EXR image using the R-PPNE method
debayer_raw_images: debayer RAW camera images into 16-bit linear TIFF images using dcraw_emu
extract_exif_metadata: extract EXIF metadata and compute exposure value from a RAW image file
compute_hdr_psnr: compute per-exposure PSNR between a reconstructed HDR image and the RAW input images
calculate_auto_exposure: calculate automatic exposure compensation for an HDR image to achieve a target mean brightness
